name: Canyon Bakehouse Gluten-Free Plain Bagels
whyItWorks: 100% whole grain brown rice, tapioca, and potato flour blend; free from gluten, dairy, nuts, and soy. Delivers the classic chewy boiled bagel experience without provoking immune or gluten sensitivities.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Slice and toast in a toaster oven for 3 minutes until crisp on the edges.
